items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: The interviewee (Chris Brubeck) does not mention Monk Rowe. The interviewer (Monk Rowe) mentions being on a tour with his father (Dave Brubeck), but the interviewee does not confirm or deny knowing Monk Rowe personally, nor does he describe a relationship with him.

ctx.x: Chris and Dan were interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 19, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are at the morning after with Dan and Chris Brubeck, who played a marvelous concert in Wellin Hall at Hamilton College last night. I was enthralled by the interpretations of your father’s music. The core of them were there but how do you decide to bring them alive so that they fit the way you play?

I think you know certain things, I’ll hear other ways to play something like for instance in “Kathy’s Waltz,” I’ve always heard that that could be a great kind of reggae-feeling thing, which you wouldn’t think of right away but we tried it and it was like hey that actually works great. And I remember at the recording session Mike had worked out this whole opening thing and it was like, “Oh yeah, that works great but I’d really like to play a chordal guitar thing.” And it was like, “Well do that in the beginning…
